gold_review.explanation: Gold answer is a JSON list of tool calls but the env only parses native tool_calls or text wrapped in <tool_call>...</tool_call> tags, then expects DONE/finish_ordering_tests in a multi-turn loop; our raw/boxed/xml variants have no <tool_call> tags so zero orders register.
gold_review.evidence: order_medical_test_tool_call.py:66 re.finditer(r"<tool_call>\s*(.*?)\s*(?:</tool_call>|$)"); :525 "order a test using the tool call format ... or respond with DONE"
